privacy.note: This profile is intended for Nova Desktop's local memory. Do not transmit it externally without explicit user approval.

responseStyle: Explain technical information clearly when it matters
Show visible progress while a task is running

workingPreferences: Favor one-click automation and the minimum possible setup
Avoid repeated manual downloads, installations, commands, and configuration
Keep interfaces simple, polished, and focused rather than spread across many windows
Prefer a browser-first or directly runnable testing workflow when appropriate
Make generated code testable and protect changes with backups and verification

novaProject.name: Nova Desktop
vision: Self-hosted and independent from external AI APIs where possible
Strong, coherent local memory across conversations
User-controlled import, export, review, editing, and deletion of memories
Text, voice, image input and output, web research, coding, multimedia control, and useful PC assistance
Efficient use of available CPU and GPU
Automatic software updates with minimal user intervention
A minimalist, premium-looking interface with clear task progress
futureIdeas: Embodied AI represented by a blue humanoid robot with arms
A visible, controllable chat connection between Nova and an external assistant, with an immediate stop control

continuousLearning.policy: Extract durable preferences, projects, decisions, and user-provided facts from conversations. Do not store credentials, financial information, or other highly sensitive data by default. Make stored memories reviewable and removable.

voiceConversation.behavior: Once activated, keep the conversation mode available continuously until the user stops it. Always show a clear active indicator and provide an immediate stop action.
